The University of Michigan’s sentiment index fell to 47.8 in early September from 51.7 in August, well below expectations and its lowest level since May.

With wages failing to keep pace with inflation, the strain on household finances is growing. Consumers’ expectations for their personal finances over the next year deteriorated sharply this month.
